summary: 100-foot steel tower on Rock Mountain, Jefferson County, Alabama, built 1941 and named for conservationist F.M. Tedd Joy; no readable source on current access.

events.note: Built for the Department of Forestry by the Civilian Conservation Corps, per a December 1944 article as quoted in a Facebook post; another quotation of the same article says the Division of Forestry built it
Anniston Star item of December 28, 1942 describes the tower as already named for Joy
A towerman kept constant watch for fire, per the 1944 article
Dedication on November 9 at the Jefferson County Courthouse, with a granite tablet at the base; year inferred from the December 1944 issue date, not stated in the quoted passage
New road built to the tower in the early 1970s and never used; the tower stayed unmanned afterward (per an undated post; 1970 is the start of the early 1970s)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The December 1942 Anniston Star item already calls the tower named for Joy, while the 1944 article says the naming was decided right after his death. The readable text does not reconcile the two.
Two quotations of the same December 1944 article differ. One says the Civilian Conservation Corps built the tower for the Department of Forestry; the other says the Division of Forestry built it.

notes_for_editor: The register has no build year. The 1941 build date, the CCC attribution and the 1944 dedication come from two undated Bill Coleman Facebook posts that quote a December 1944 Alabama Conservation article; the article itself was not read. The two posts quote the article differently on who built the tower (see resolved_conflicts). The dedication year is inferred from the issue date and is not stated in the quoted passage. A Birmingham wiki timeline that search surfaced gives November 9, 1943 and a 1941 CCC build; bhamwiki.com returns 403 to our reader, so it is unverified and not cited. Access, the sanctuary's current ownership and current condition are unknown; the 2016 register entry is the only later dated source. No photos added. Not verified: whether anything has changed since 2016.
